as_told.title: Ted Owens' powers from the mantids Twitter and Tweeter

plain: A man named Ted Owens claimed he could move things with his mind by sending telepathic messages to 'space intelligences', insect-like beings resembling praying mantises who ride in an invisible giant UFO above the Earth. A researcher of the paranormal named Jeffrey Mishlove quotes Owens as saying 'I send telepathic messages to my friends' and 'they do it.' A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells it too, saying Owens named the mantids Twitter and Tweeter and said they gave him his powers.
